note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (rename *, lower at line 29; rename block lines 38-44; Bookmark #1: Water, lines 247-297) lowercases every column and renames P04A01A1..A5, P04A01B to w_p04a01a1..w_p04a01a5, w_p04a01b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The screener P04A01 is not renamed and not in this table. The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 42-47) labels each column, 6/6, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed numbering (P04A01A rows 1-5; P04A01B). Step 3b: live items (6; resp 1-10 overall) match the questionnaire's drinking-water block exactly; the dictionary description ('access to and satisfaction with municipal drinking water services') agrees; no instrument mismatch. Note the block is not municipal-only: community water systems (P04A01=2) also answered. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.3 (checked against the rendered page image at 200 dpi); the dictionary variable labels agree character-for-character on 6/6 items, so no wording overrides. Printed line breaks (A4, A5, B stem) joined with a single space; the wide gaps in the justified B stem on the page ('nada  satisfecho(a)', 'totalmente  satisfecho(a)') are typesetting, and the dictionary label has single spaces, as shipped. The lead-in reads 'De acuerdo a su experiencia' (not 'con' as in sibling blocks), transcribed as printed. Structure (mirrors guatemala_2024_homes_trash / _transport): the P04A01A lead-in 'De acuerdo a su experiencia, el agua potable en este lugar:' is shared by A1-A5 -> section_prompt of section _1; P04A01B -> section _2, no prompt. instructions blank: the left-hand cell is the screener question P04A01 ('El servicio de agua potable de su hogar es:' with options Municipal 1 / Comunitario 2 / Pozo privado o propio 3 / No tiene 4 / Otro, ¿cuál?... 98 plus an Especifique line), which is a question not in this table rather than framing text, so it is not shipped; it is described in the public_note because it defines who answered. Interviewer lines 'Espere la respuesta.' / 'Lea las opciones.' and the routing box 'PASE A PREGUNTA P04A02' not shipped. Options as printed: A1-A5 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 NS (don't know) is kept on A1-A5 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P04A01B prints bare 1-10 bubbles plus 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' (dictionary value labels = own number); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Item content notes: A5 (bribe request) is negatively worded, so SÍ is the unfavourable answer there. Skip pattern (verified in source): the printed routing box groups 'Pozo privado o propio' (3), 'No tiene' (4) and 'Otro, ¿cuál?...' (98) with an arrow to 'PASE A PREGUNTA P04A02', so only households with municipal (1) or community (2) water service answered this block. In ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx P04A01 = 1/2/3/4/98 = 3623/1864/488/831/80 (no blanks); exactly the 5,487 P04A01 in {1,2} households are non-blank on all six columns and all 1,399 others are blank on all six. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 25/25 valid item x resp cells equal (a1 1/2/3 = 3068/2374/45; a2 4290/1137/60; a3 2655/2656/176; a4 3464/1824/199; a5 285/5123/79; b 1..10 = 243/104/131/128/778/301/496/983/428/1650) and 6/6 NULL cells equal source blank (+98 for b): a1-a5 1399 each, b 1644 = 1399 + 245.
